<style>
/* Keep the Box Breathing page on one predictable layout. The shared tool CSS
   also defines a two-column Box Breathing layout; after the branch
   consolidation that left the duration controls squeezed into the right-hand
   column. Long labels and full-width number inputs could then collide. */
#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-tool {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-stage {
  min-width: 0;
}

#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-settings {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem 1rem;
  width: min(100%, 64rem);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-settings > label {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  white-space: normal;
}

#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-settings > label input {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-actions {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

/* The safety message is presented once, below the exercise. */
#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-safety,
#box-breathing-app .box-breathing-tool + .skill-app-note {
  display: none !important;
}

.box-breathing-page-safety {
  max-width: 72rem;
  margin: 1rem auto 1.5rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border-left: 0.3rem solid #6f4e37;
  background: #f4efe9;
}

#box-breathing-app .skill-app-footer,
#box-breathing-app [data-skill-progress-final],
#box-breathing-app [data-skill-progress-open],
body:has(#box-breathing-app) [data-skill-progress-floating] {
  display: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #box-breathing-app .box-breathing-settings {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  #box-breathing-app .box-breathing-settings {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
</style>

Box Breathing appears in the Free Therapy Tools source list. The source does not prescribe timings, so this tool's equal four-second defaults are adjustable.
